name: Good Shepherd
body:
When you can no longer spare the rod, the rod can at least spare you.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus with any bludgeoning weapon, Craft Rod or Craft Staff.

Benefit: You gain a +1 shield bonus when wielding a rod or staff that you have created. This bonus stacks with other shield bonuses.
